title: Late infancy — overview — for new parents
summary: Developmental stage Late infancy (8-12 months). Late infancy (8-12 months): Sits without support; pulls to stand; says mama and dada; waves bye-bye. If this is your first time, start small and give yourself grace. Every child develops at their own pace; milestones are guides, not deadlines.
